  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  JULY 17, 2026

A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by the City Clerk at 9:00 a.m., on,
Friday, July 17, 2026, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA.

Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Caroline Torosis (arrived at 9:03 a.m.)
  Mayor Pro Tem Jesse Zwick (arrived at 9:04 a.m.)
  Councilmember Lana Negrete
  Councilmember Dan Hall
  Councilmember Ellis Raskin
  Councilmember Barry Snell
  Councilmember Natalya Zernitskaya

  Also Present:  City Manager Oliver Chi
  City Attorney Heidi von Tongeln
  Interim City Clerk Denise Anderson-Warren

 CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the City Clerk, the City Council convened at 9:00 a.m., with all
  members present except Mayor Pro Tem Zwick and Mayor Torosis.

  Motion by Councilmember Raskin, seconded by Councilmember
  Zernitskaya, to have Councilmember Hall Chair the meeting in the absence
  of the Mayor and Mayor Pro Tem. The motion was unanimously approved
  by voice vote, with Mayor Pro Tem Zwick and Mayor Torosis, absent.

  Councilmember Raskin led the assemblage in the Pledge of Allegiance.

 STATEMENT OF  The City of Santa Monica Statement of Accountability (Land
 ACCOUNTABILITY  Acknowledgement) was read into the record by Councilmember Snell.
